summary: Server one-frame event on an item dropped out of an inventory into the world. Added by bg3.exe+0x348C240 from bg3.exe+0x347F3C0 (per-frame update of esv::inventory::InteractionSystem), copying a 0xC0-byte drop record of a hash map keyed by the item; read by esv::inventory::LevelRegisterSystem::ProcessDroppedMembers and esv::inventory::MemberTransformSystem (macOS index).
